exposure: gestational age at elective repeat cesarean delivery
cohort: Low-risk women in Ontario, Canada who underwent elective repeat cesarean delivery between 37 and 40 weeks gestation in fiscal years 2012-2013 and 2013-2014
finding: Restricting repeat cesarean delivery in low-risk women to or after 39 weeks gestation would be a cost-effective strategy, leading to net annual savings on both "baby only" and "dyad" costs.
